doctors.name: Dr. Meera Raghavan
doctors.lead: Senior consultant leading the Hearing & Balance Clinic. She has performed over 600 ear surgeries and 120 cochlear implants.
bio: Dr. Meera completed her ENT training in Coimbatore and a fellowship in otology in Chennai. She founded the clinic's Hearing & Balance programme in 2014 and runs the newborn hearing screening service with partner maternity hospitals.
Her clinical focus is chronic ear disease, hearing restoration and vertigo. She sees adult and paediatric patients.

doctors.name: Dr. Arjun Venkatesh
doctors.lead: Lead rhinologist with more than 1,400 endoscopic sinus operations. He runs the clinic's sinus, allergy and snoring programmes.
bio: Dr. Arjun trained in Coimbatore and Edinburgh, followed by a rhinology fellowship focused on endoscopic sinus and skull-base surgery. He introduced day-care FESS at Tridya in 2016.
He sees adults with chronic sinusitis, nasal polyps, a blocked nose and allergy, and works with the sleep team on snoring and sleep apnoea surgery.

doctors.name: Dr. Kavitha Sundaram
doctors.lead: Voice specialist for teachers, singers and anyone whose work depends on speaking. She leads the Voice & Swallowing Clinic.
bio: Dr. Kavitha completed her ENT training in Chennai and a laryngology fellowship in Singapore, where she worked with professional voice users. She set up Tridya's video stroboscopy service in 2019.
She treats hoarseness, vocal cord lesions, reflux and swallowing problems, working side by side with the clinic's speech-language pathologist.
